chat.message: I'm at the Ferry Building entrance, near the clock tower. I don't see you.
I'm at the entrance too, where are you? I don't see your car.
I'm at the pin location. It says Ferry Building but I'm on the Embarcadero side. Are you on the Market Street side?
Oh. I think I may have dropped the pin at the wrong entrance. I'm near Market, not Embarcadero. Can you come over here?
I waited 8 minutes at the pin. I have to move on, I have another pickup. The fee is going to stand.
That's not fair. You never came to where I actually was. I'm disputing this charge.

dispute.driver_statement: I arrived at the pin location on the Embarcadero side of the Ferry Building at 7:04. The rider was not there. I sent three messages over 8 minutes. At 7:10 she finally said she was at the wrong entrance — 180 meters away. I had already waited the full window and had another pickup. The no-show fee is standard. She's filed 6 disputes in the last 3 months.
dispute.rider_statement: The driver never showed up at my location. He was 180 meters away on the other side of the Ferry Building and refused to come to where I was standing. I waited 8 minutes in the cold. He then drove off and I was charged a $7 no-show fee. Yes, I may have dropped the pin at the wrong entrance, but the driver should have come to me when I told him where I was. I have dashcam footage from my Uber dashcam that shows I was at the Market Street entrance the entire time.

policies.rule_text: Where the driver did not come within 100 metres of the pickup pin, the no-show fee is refunded in full.
policies.title: Driver Non-Arrival

policies.rule_text: Where the driver came within 50 metres of the pickup pin, waited at least 5 minutes, and rider telemetry shows no movement toward the vehicle, the no-show fee stands.
policies.title: Driver Arrival - Fee Stands

policies.rule_text: Where the facts fall between the Policy 2.1a and 2.1b thresholds, the matter is not determinable on the record and is referred to human review.
policies.title: Grey-Band Referral

policies.rule_text: A rider who cancels within 2 minutes of acceptance without moving toward the pickup is not charged a no-show fee.
policies.title: Rider Cancellation Window
